rapport_notes: Patient answering several rapid-fire questions clearly and warmly.

evidence_quotes.agenda: quick question for you aside from the quote, the pricing in general do you have any specific concerns or any important questions you want answers to on this call?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer asked about truck necessity, additional disassembly charges, and labor-only pricing; rep answered each and she confirmed 'Alright, I think that answers all my questions.'

top_strength: Asked the 'their agenda' question early and directly addressed every follow-up question the caller raised (truck necessity, additional fees, labor-only option) until she said it answered everything.
coaching_note: No Save Your Ass framing (rate commitment, window language, beats-it-pay-less, self-prep tip) was used before wrapping up — worth adding at least one of these before the close.
